# Configuration

One optional file, `config.toml`, in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gitterrace` or `~/.config/gitterrace`
(`--config DIR` picks another folder). It is never read from a served repository. A flag beats the
file, the file beats the default. Unknown keys warn, invalid values stop startup naming the key.
`git terrace config` prints what is in force and where each value came from.

A running server reloads `config.toml` within a second of an edit. An invalid edit is logged with
the key and the old settings stay. Open pages show "Updated, refresh". Settings marked "Needs a
restart" log a warning and keep their running value.

Per-repository overrides go under `[repo.NAME]` (the repository's folder name) and take `exclude`, a
list of path globs added to `insights.exclude`.

Actions live in their own file, `actions.toml`, because they run commands.

## `[server]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `addr` | string | `"127.0.0.1:4242"` | Address to listen on. Keep it local: pages show source code and there is no login. Needs a restart. |
| `max_streams` | integer | `32` | Maximum open live-update streams per repository (one per browser tab). |
| `public` | bool | `false` | Serve read-only to anyone who can reach the address: committed history only, no working tree, stashes, live updates, actions or additions. Required for any address that is not loopback. Needs a restart. |
| `hosts` | list of strings | `[]` | Host names a reverse proxy forwards with, exact and without port, for example `["git.example.com"]`. Needs `public`. Needs a restart. |

## `[watch]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` | Notice new commits and refs while running. Off means a restart or a reload is needed. |
| `interval_ms` | integer | `1000` | How often to check each served repository for changes, in milliseconds. A check is a few `stat` calls. Minimum 250. |

## `[index]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build_on_start` | bool | `true` | Build the commit index as soon as a repository is served: at startup for one repository, at its first visit when several share the server. Off waits for the first page that needs it (Insights). |
| `threads` | integer | `0` | Threads that parse the index. 0 means one per core, capped at 8. Needs a restart. |

## `[resources]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_mb` | integer | `64` | Memory for the blame and highlighted-code caches together, in MB, shared half and half. The highlighted-code cache is per process, the blame cache per repository. |
| `blocking_jobs` | integer | `0` | Most page-building git jobs running at once across all repositories. 0 means one per core. |

## `[limits]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text_kb` | integer | `2048` | Largest file shown as text, in KiB. Larger files are offered as raw downloads. |
| `raw_mb` | integer | `256` | Largest file served raw, in MB. |
| `search_matches` | integer | `500` | Most matches a code search returns. |
| `diff_fold_lines` | integer | `400` | Lines of one file's diff shown before it folds. |

## `[insights]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exclude` | list of strings | `[]` | Paths (globs) left out of every insight. |
| `bots` | bool | `false` | Count commits by bots. |
| `generated` | bool | `false` | Count lock files and minified output. |
| `period` | string | `"all"` | Period the insights pages use when the URL names none: 1w, 1m, 3m, 1y or all. The API and MCP default to all. Their `period` parameter picks one. |

## `[display]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | string | `"system"` | Color theme before the visitor picks one: system, light or dark. |
| `dates` | string | `"relative"` | How dates read: relative or absolute. |

## `[multi]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | integer | `2` | How many folder levels to search below a given folder for repositories. Needs a restart. |
| `skip_dirs` | list of strings | `["node_modules", "target", ".wt"]` | Folder names never searched, besides hidden ones. Needs a restart. |

## `[links]`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `style` | string | `"gitterrace"` | Form of the permalink Copy permalink, Send to, action payloads and the MCP hand out: gitterrace (`gitterrace://<id>/<sha>/<path>`, opened by `git terrace open` without a running server) or go (`http://<addr>/go/...`, needs this server running). |
| `roots` | list of strings | `[]` | Folders `git terrace open` searches, `multi.depth` levels deep, for a clone a link names, besides every repository served before. |
